questions: What should happen when the matrix-tensor multiplication yields a 2D array with zero columns (e.g., T has shape (k, 0, m) or (k, n, 0))?
Should the StandardScaler be fitted on the entire result array (global normalization) or per row/column?
What should be the index of the returned DataFrame? Should it be default RangeIndex or something else?
Is the matrix-tensor multiplication specifically along the first dimension of T (axis 0) as stated, or along the second dimension of P (axis 1)?
Should the function handle non-numeric inputs (e.g., strings or None) in P or T, or assume they are numeric arrays?
What should happen if P or T contains NaN or infinite values?
Should the normalization preserve the data type (e.g., convert to float64) or allow other dtypes?
Is the flattening of the result always along the last two dimensions of the tensor product (after swapaxes), or should it be along all dimensions except the first?
